div.head: II Cn 30
div.ab: And gyf hwylc man si swa ungetrywe þam hundrede ⁊ swa tihtbysig, ⁊ hine þonne þreo men ætgædere teon, ðonne ne beo þær nan oðer, butan þæt he gange to ðam þryfealdan ordale.
Swyðe ungetreowe. ⁊ gyf hwylc man sy swa ungetreowe ðam hundrede ⁊ swa tihtbysig, ⁊ hine ðreo men ætgædere téon, ðonne ne beo ðær nan oðær, buton ðæt hé ga to ðam ðrifealdan ordale.
And gyf hwylc man sy swa untrywe þam hundrede ⁊ swa tyhtbysig, ⁊ hine þonne þry men ætgedere teon, þonne ne beo þær nan oðor, buton þæt he gange to þam þrifealdan ordale.
Si quis adeo sit incredibilis hundreto, et a tribus simul accusetur, tunc nichil aliud interueniat, quin ad triplex ordalium eat.
Si quis est infidelis hundredo suo et sepe est calumniatus, si simul uno die tribus calumniis proclamatus fuerit, triplici iudicio se purget.
Et si quis centenario adeo suspectus est adeoque calumpniosus, ut a tribus calumpniatoribus simul calumpnietur, tunc nichil aliud fiat, nisi quod ad triplex Dei iudicium eat.
Swyðe ungetreowe. ⁊ gyf hwylc man sy swa ungetreowe ðam hundrede ⁊ swa tihtbysig ⁊ hine ðreo men ætgædere téon, ðonne ne beo ðær nan oðer, buton ðæt hé ga to ðam ðrifealdan ordale.
And gyf hwylc man si swa ungetrywe þam hundrede and swa tihtbysig, and hine þonne þreo men ætgædere teon, ðonne ne beo þær nan oðer butan þæt he gange to ðam þryfealdan ordale.

(Sehr Vertrauens Unwürdige. B) Und wenn jemand dem Hundertgericht so sehr Vertrauens unwürdig und so oft bescholten ist, und ihn nun drei Männer zusammen anklagen, dann sei da nichts anderes [ihm übrig], als dass er zum dreifachen Ordale schreite.

(The very untrustworthy. B) And if anyone is so untrustworthy to the hundred and so often accused, and three men then accuse him together, then let there be nothing else [left for him] but to go to the threefold ordeal.

Thoroughly untrustworthy men. If anyone has forfeited the confidence of the hundred, and has charges brought against him to such an extent that he is accused by three men at once, no other course shall be open to him but to go to the triple ordeal.

And if any man is so regarded with suspicion by the hundred and so frequently accused, and three men together then accuse him, there is then to be nothing for it but that he is to go to the three-fold ordeal.

And if anyone deemed especially untrustworthy by the hundred and especially frequently accused is charged by three men at once, then he shall have no other recourse except to undergo the threefold ordeal.

Wiederholt durch Hn 65, 3, übersetzt durch Leis Wl 51.—Dieselbe Atr-Stelle ward schon o. 22 benutzt
Repeated by Hn 65, 3, translated by Leis Wl 51.—The same passage of Atr was already used above 22
‘indem’ verstehen Cons, Schmid 662b und ich o. II 305 Sp. 3. Dagegen tritt zur Bescholtenheit diese Anklage, laut þonne, neu hinzu, als zweite Bedingung bei den Übersetzern Q Hn Inst Wl

Cons, Schmid 662b and I myself above II 305 col. 3 understand ‘in that’. On the contrary, as þonne shows, this accusation is a fresh addition to the ill repute, a second condition, in the translators Q Hn Inst Wl
‘IIII’ Wl.—Nicht drei Klagen, wie Inst versteht, sondern drei Kläger für Eine Schuld treten auf. Auch o. I 5a verstand Inst drei Klagen statt ‘einer dreifachen Anklage’
‘IIII’ Wl.—Not three charges, as Inst understands, but three accusers for one offence appear. Above I 5a too Inst understood three charges instead of ‘a threefold accusation’

Cf. adeo suspectus…ut, Cons. This use of and is rare and is not recognised in dictionaries. It is somewhat parallel, however, to its use after gelice and compounds of efen, etc., see Toller, Suppl. p. 38, s.v. and, iv.
